scoringScale.difficulty: 1 = small PoC slice with existing server/client patterns; 5 = new systems, legal/rights gates, or cross-player state at scale
scoringScale.effortHours: Rough engineering + minimal design for a PoC-quality slice, not full production polish
scoringScale.recommendation: now = prove/extend current PoC wedge; next = after tomorrow-return/share funnel is credible; later = post-election or expansion; no = rejected/inverted/superseded mechanic
